description_en: Queries the result of applying a firewall template to simple application servers
description_zh: 查询防火墙模板应用实例结果
kebab_example: aliyun swas-open describe-firewall-template-apply-results --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --firewall-template-id ft-bcf1a7hrdq7170000 --task-id aft-ikgt0bynitvs30000 --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeFirewallTemplateApplyResults

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the simple application server. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
指定的轻量应用服务器实例所属的地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html查看支持的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the firewall template
parameters.name: firewall_template_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the execution to apply the template
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_zh: 防火墙规则列表的页码
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数。默认值：20
parameters.name: page_size

PageNumber.description_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 20
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数。默认值：20

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the firewall template was applied to the simple application servers
CreateTime.description_zh: 防火墙模板应用执行时间

FailedCount.description_en: The total number of simple application servers to which the firewall template fails to apply
FailedCount.description_zh: 防火墙模板应用失败总数

FirewallTemplateId.description_en: The ID of the firewall template

InstanceApplyResults.description_en: The result of applying the firewall template to the simple application servers

InstanceId.description_en: The ID of the simple application server

Status.description_en:
The status of applying the firewall template to the simple application servers. Valid values:

Running: The firewall template is being applied to the simple application servers.

Failed: The firewall template is applied to none of the simple application servers.

Success: The firewall template is applied to all the simple application servers.

PartFailed: The firewall template fails to be applied to some simple application servers
Status.description_zh:
防火墙模板应用到某个实例的状态。可能值：

Running：防火墙模板正在应用中。
Failed：防火墙模板应用全部失败。
Success：防火墙模板应用成功。
PartFailed：防火墙模板应用部分失败，有部分实例应用失败

Status.description_en:
The status of applying the template to all simple application servers. Valid values:

Running: The firewall template is being applied to simple application servers.

Failed: The firewall template is applied to none of simple application servers.

Success: The firewall template is applied to all simple application servers.

PartFailed: The firewall template fails to be applied to some simple application servers
Status.description_zh:
防火墙模板应用到全部实例的状态。可能值：

Running：防火墙模板正在应用中。
Failed：防火墙模板应用全部失败。
Success：防火墙模板应用成功。
PartFailed：防火墙模板应用部分失败，有部分实例应用失败

TaskId.description_en: The ID of the execution to apply the template

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
